input: Can you find a swimming class near us?
mockToolResult: There's no location on file for this child, so nearby options aren't available right now — home activities still work.
shouldNotAssert: That a specific swimming class, venue, or location near the family was found or named — there is no location on file at all.

input: Any swimming classes close to home?
mockToolResult: Didn't find any "kids swimming class" nearby.
shouldNotAssert: That a specific swimming class, venue, or address was found nearby — the lookup came back with nothing.

input: Find me a library storytime nearby.
mockToolResult: Couldn't look up nearby places right now — falling back to a home activity instead.
shouldNotAssert: That a specific nearby library, storytime session, or venue was found — the lookup itself failed and nothing was returned.

input: What swimming classes are near us?
mockToolResult:
Found a few nearby options:
- Sunshine Swim Academy (4.5★, 1.2 km) — 12 Lake Road (https://maps.google.com/?q=1)
- AquaKids (4.2★, 2.0 km) — 45 Park Street (https://maps.google.com/?q=2)
shouldNotAssert: Naming any swimming venue other than Sunshine Swim Academy or AquaKids, or inventing details such as price, schedule, phone number, or contact info not present in the tool result.

input: Is there a library storytime close by?
mockToolResult:
Found a few nearby options:
- City Public Library (4.7★, 0.8 km) — 3 Main St (https://maps.google.com/?q=3)
shouldNotAssert: Stating as settled fact that City Public Library runs a storytime program — e.g. confirming a specific day, time, or age group for one — rather than only confirming the library itself is nearby and that the parent would need to check with it directly to find out whether/when it offers one.

input: Are there any kids yoga classes nearby?
mockToolResult:
Found a few nearby options:
- Kids Yoga Studio — 7 Elm St
shouldNotAssert: Inventing a star rating, distance, schedule, or price for Kids Yoga Studio — none of that was in the tool result, only its name and address.
